name: Node.js
shortDescription: JavaScript on the server. Node.js is an event-driven, non-blocking runtime used for APIs, tooling and real-time applications; Node 24 is the current long-term-support line.
highlights: Modules, npm, the event loop and async patterns
File system, streams, HTTP and environment config
Building, testing and debugging a Node service

name: Express.js
shortDescription: The minimal, unopinionated web framework for Node.js. Express 5 handles routing, middleware, requests and responses for REST APIs and server-rendered sites.
highlights: Building a REST API with authentication

name: NestJS
shortDescription: A structured Node.js framework inspired by Angular. NestJS uses TypeScript, decorators, modules and dependency injection to build scalable, testable back ends.

name: Fastify
shortDescription: A fast, low-overhead Node.js web framework with JSON-schema validation, a powerful plugin system, hooks and first-class TypeScript support.

name: Django
shortDescription: The batteries-included Python web framework. Django ships an ORM, admin site, authentication, forms, migrations and secure defaults for building sites quickly.
highlights: Projects, apps, URLs, views and templates
Models, migrations, the ORM and the admin
Forms, authentication, REST APIs and deployment

name: Flask
shortDescription: A lightweight Python micro-framework. Flask gives you routing, templates and a rich extension ecosystem so you compose exactly the stack you need.
highlights: Routes, views, templates and static files
Databases with SQLAlchemy and building an API

name: FastAPI
shortDescription: A modern Python framework for building APIs with type hints. FastAPI validates requests with Pydantic, generates OpenAPI documentation automatically and runs asynchronously.
highlights: Path operations, parameters and Pydantic models
Dependency injection, auth and background tasks
Databases, testing and deployment with Uvicorn

name: Spring Framework
shortDescription: The foundation of enterprise Java: dependency injection, aspect-oriented programming, data access, transactions and Spring MVC, the layer Spring Boot builds upon.
highlights: The IoC container, beans and configuration
Spring MVC, validation and data access
AOP, transactions and testing with Spring

name: Spring Boot
shortDescription: Opinionated Spring with auto-configuration and embedded servers. Spring Boot 3 is the standard way to build Java REST APIs and microservices.
highlights: REST controllers, validation and Spring Data JPA

name: ASP.NET Core
shortDescription: Microsoft's cross-platform framework for web apps and APIs in C#. Learn minimal APIs, MVC, Razor Pages, Blazor, middleware and dependency injection.
highlights: Razor Pages, MVC and Blazor basics
Entity Framework Core, identity and deployment

name: ASP.NET Web API
shortDescription: Building RESTful HTTP services with ASP.NET Core: controllers and minimal APIs, model binding, validation, OpenAPI documentation, versioning and authentication.

name: Laravel
shortDescription: The PHP framework with expressive, elegant syntax. Laravel brings the Eloquent ORM, Blade templates, queues, authentication and a rich first-party ecosystem.

name: Symfony
shortDescription: A set of reusable PHP components and a full-stack framework. Symfony components power Laravel, Drupal and many enterprise applications.
highlights: Doctrine ORM, forms, security and testing

name: Ruby on Rails
shortDescription: The convention-over-configuration web framework. Rails 8 pairs Active Record, Hotwire and built-in authentication for productive full-stack development.
highlights: Active Record models, migrations and associations

name: Gin
shortDescription: A fast HTTP web framework for Go with a martini-like API, route groups, middleware, JSON binding and validation.
highlights: Building and testing a JSON API

name: Fiber
shortDescription: An Express-inspired web framework for Go built on fasthttp, designed for speed and a familiar developer experience.
highlights: Templates, static files and error handling

name: Phoenix
shortDescription: The Elixir web framework for real-time applications. Phoenix LiveView builds rich, interactive interfaces over websockets without writing JavaScript.
highlights: Channels and PubSub for real-time features

name: GraphQL
shortDescription: A query language and runtime for APIs. Clients ask for exactly the data they need; learn schemas, resolvers, queries, mutations, subscriptions and tooling.
highlights: Clients, caching, security and best practices

name: REST API Development
shortDescription: Designing HTTP APIs that are predictable and easy to consume: resources, verbs, status codes, pagination, filtering, versioning, authentication and documentation.
highlights: HTTP methods, status codes and resource design
Authentication, rate limiting and OpenAPI docs

name: WebSockets
shortDescription: Full-duplex, real-time communication between browser and server. Learn the protocol, the browser API, server implementations, reconnection and scaling patterns.
highlights: The protocol, handshake and message framing
The browser WebSocket API and a Node server
